# SimpleINSURE Brokerage LLC

> Independent New York property and casualty insurance broker in Garden City, NY (900 Stewart Ave Ste 210, Garden City, NY 11530; (516) 226-7969; info@simpleinsure.co). NY DFS license BR-1984615. Serves Nassau County, Suffolk County and New York City. Licensed in New York; this site does not offer coverage in other states.

We place commercial insurance for building owners, contractors, restaurants and small businesses, plus homeowners and personal umbrella coverage. We are usually paid a commission by the insurer. You can ask what we expect on your own policy. Coverage descriptions on this site are general summaries. The issued policy governs.

## Pages
- [Coverage](https://www.simpleinsure.co/coverage/): lines we place, by type of client
- [Contractor and builders risk insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/new-york-contractor-insurance/): who buys builders risk, Labor Law 240 and action over claims, NYC Buildings permit insurance, and Nassau County contractor certificates
- [Apartment, mixed-use and rental building insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/new-york-building-insurance/): New York City apartment building insurance, and loss of rents versus unpaid rent
- [Landlord insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/landlord-insurance/): apartment buildings and rentals of 1 to 50 units in New York City and on Long Island, including loss of rents versus unpaid rent
- [NYC landlord and building insurance statistics, 2026](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nyc-landlord-insurance-statistics/): sourced counts for small buildings, insurance costs, violations, fires, flood, and rent-stabilized units, plus the 2026 SimpleINSURE NYC Small Building Index
- [Free landlord policy checkup](https://www.simpleinsure.co/landlord-checkup/): send declarations pages and the property address. A licensed broker reviews the coverage and gets back to you. Free, no obligation.
- [Landlord insurance in Nassau and Suffolk County](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nassau-suffolk-landlord-insurance/): Long Island rental houses, two-family homes and small apartment buildings
- [NYC mixed-use building insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nyc-mixed-use-building-insurance/): stores below, apartments above, in the five boroughs
- [Restaurant insurance on Long Island](https://www.simpleinsure.co/long-island-restaurant-insurance/): restaurants, delis, cafes and bars in Nassau and Suffolk
- [NYC landlord insurance requirements](https://www.simpleinsure.co/landlord-insurance-requirements-nyc/): what lenders, the law and contracts ask NYC landlords to carry
- [NYC restaurant insurance requirements](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nyc-restaurant-insurance-requirements/): what New York restaurants must carry and what leases ask for
- [Restaurant and food business insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/new-york-restaurant-insurance/): restaurants, cafes, and delis in New York City and Nassau
- [Businessowners policy (BOP)](https://www.simpleinsure.co/business-owners-policy/): what a BOP covers, and how it differs from general liability alone
- [Nassau County commercial insurance](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nassau-county-commercial-insurance/): Garden City broker, including what Nassau County requires on a contractor certificate of insurance
- [Policy review](https://www.simpleinsure.co/policy-review/): how to send a policy for review and how a broker of record change works
